agents.name: Implementation Lead
agents.instructions: Check readiness, assign work and verify evidence and handoffs.
agents.authority: May dispatch ready tasks. Escalate scope and acceptance to the story owner.

agents.name: Invoice Builder
agents.instructions: Implement the assigned queue change and hand over the exact revision.
agents.authority: May edit the assigned branch. Escalate scope changes to the lead.

agents.name: Fixture Loader
agents.instructions: Load the approved synthetic fixture set in the test environment.
agents.authority: Use the approved test environment and fixture set.

agents.name: Invoice Verifier
agents.instructions: Verify the built behavior against the assigned checklist completion check.
agents.authority: Report checklist verification to the lead and return defects for repair.

agents.name: Acceptance Tester
agents.instructions: Start a fresh session after prerequisites pass. Check A-01 on the exact build with approved synthetic invoices. Record evidence by criterion and scenario.
agents.authority: Report test outcomes. Record an access or runtime blocker and leave the check unpassed if the required session is unavailable.
